post_policy: prose_only; whole-document disclosure quarantine; no CVE deletion
group_policy: Union across datasets of identical CVE IDs, normalized accepted D/M text, and existing Reddit evidence components; URLs alone do not merge distinct CVEs.
role_policy: SHA256(seed + sorted component members) modulo 10000; no label stratification, seed search or redraw
interpretation: Retrospective same-day catalogue membership; not future exploitation or future listing prediction. Inner assessment uses previously studied training records.
missing_epss: null plus observed mask; fitting-only median and missing mask for numerical models; raw EPSS ranking additionally reported on the observed subset
cache_policy: No prior EPSS-study cache is approved automatically. Reuse requires exact screened text, document order, processing and encoder identity; a separate cache stage must verify it.
